title: scorzoneroides autumnalis var. dentata
intro: Scorzoneroides autumnalis var. dentata, commonly known as Autumn Knitweed or Autumnal Knitgrass, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Scorzoneroides autumnalis var. dentata are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
